The author / An imagined biography

A life spent
looking sideways.

“The ordinary world is strange enough. You only have to stand a little further away.”

Mara Vey is the fictional voice behind The Meridian Archive: a writer of speculative novels about memory, language and the places we build to keep ourselves safe.

In this imagined biography, she grew up near a tidal estuary, studied architecture, and spent several years drawing buildings that were never built. Fiction became another way of drawing them.

Her worlds are expansive; her questions are intimate. What do we owe the past? Who gets to name a place? What is left of a person when their memories belong to someone else?
